platform: Rust + Tauri v2 / Windows 10+ (primary desktop client); optional Electron / Windows x64 setup wizard; .NET 8 / WPF (legacy), Python/Tkinter macOS companion (legacy), static GitHub Pages website with a CSS-only backdrop

features.name: Unlocking FPS
features.details: Writes the legacy FPS flag for older client builds. Current Roblox clients use an allowlist and may silently ignore this flag. Use Roblox Settings > Maximum Framerate for the supported cap up to 240 FPS.

features.name: Texture and cache alterations
features.details: Provides texture tiers 0-3 through the allowlisted texture override, plus a conservative cleaner for old Roblox/Roptimer log and temporary files. It does not perform aggressive in-memory cache garbage collection or touch game assets.

features.name: Disable Roblox telemetry / Crashpad / Backtrace / screenshots
features.details: Hidden diagnostic and abuse-reporting flags are not on the local allowlist and are not written. Roptimer sends no analytics of its own, but it does not disable Roblox diagnostics, crash handlers, or background screenshot/reporting systems.

features.name: Extended graphic tiers
features.details: Exposes quality values 0-21 through the allowlisted FRM quality override. Values above 10 use legacy/micro levels and may look different or be ignored as Roblox changes the client.

features.name: Better FPS / optimization modes
features.details: Better FPS, Reduce building lag, Balanced, Maximum performance, Visual quality, and auto-selected mode. All modes write reversible local JSON settings only.

features.name: Reduce building lag
features.details: Reduces geometry LOD distance, grass distance, textures, MSAA and motion. It does not remove buildings, change collision, or alter gameplay geometry.

features.name: Session detection
features.details: The V4 Windows client reports whether RobloxPlayerBeta.exe appears in the OS process list using the process image name only; it does not read command-line arguments, game titles, thumbnails, server IDs/addresses, account data, player lists, chat, or memory. The legacy .NET Session page also displays local process paths and window titles.

features.name: Safe bootstrapper / CLI
features.details: RoptimerBoost.exe and Roptimer Boost.command can preview, apply, restore, inspect a session, clean old cache files, print the canonical FastFlag allowlist, launch Roblox through its normal URL scheme, and open the desktop app. Neither injects a DLL.

features.name: DLL injector / process hooks
features.details: No process injection, DLL loading, renderer hooks, memory patching, or executable modification, even when described as optimization only.

features.name: Fullbright / x-ray / building removal
features.details: No exploit-style visuals, world lighting changes, transparent walls, collision edits, or building deletion.

features.name: C# .NET 8 WPF app
features.details: Dependency-free WPF desktop app with a Bubblestrap-inspired settings layout, custom shield icon, blue Lumina theme, and local-settings-only bootstrapper.

features.name: Settings tab
features.details: Interactive website settings builder for optimization mode, FPS target, graphics tier 0-21, texture tier 0-3, cache age, generated Windows/macOS CLI commands, and the embedded FastFlag allowlist docs section.

features.name: Blue Lumina desktop interface
features.details: Blue/purple/cyan desktop app theme inspired by the provided Lumina Hub reference. No green neon status dots.

features.name: Windows EXE build
features.details: GitHub Actions builds Roptimer.exe and RoptimerBoost.exe on windows-latest. RoptimerBoost.exe open launches the desktop app; bootstrap applies safe settings first.

features.name: macOS companion downloads
features.details: Adds an unsigned Python/Tkinter macOS package with .command launchers, a .app terminal launcher, Mac path discovery for /Applications/Roblox.app/Contents/MacOS/ClientSettings, CLI parity, canonical allowlist files, docs, and a macOS build workflow.

features.name: Lightweight Sirius-style CSS-only website
features.details: Rebuilt the portal as a near-black starfield site with a Sirius-like top menu, serif hero, three main tabs, static CSS starfield and gradients, command palette, counters, scroll reveals, Windows/macOS download cards, and FastFlag allowlist docs. No WebGL renderer or Three.js runtime is loaded.

features.name: CLI and how-it-works docs
features.details: Adds a complete CLI reference, performance guide, canonical FastFlag allowlist guide, local JSON/backup explanation, macOS setup guide, GitHub Pages help, downloadable markdown docs, and a docs tab with generated commands.

features.name: Roptimer Script Hub
features.details: Original Luau-inspired local UI recipe catalog with code cards, eight screenshots, a Run preview button, and command-palette actions. It is not a Roblox executor and never sends code to a game.

features.name: GUI loading script preview
features.details: A local HTML/CSS/JavaScript loading GUI preview with steps, progress bar, and Sirius/Rayfield-like menu styling. No loadstring, game services, remote code, or executor APIs.

features.name: GitHub Pages Actions deployment
features.details: A deploy-pages.yml workflow regenerates screenshots and HTML, validates local links, checks the current Pages build type, and deploys web/ with actions/deploy-pages@v4 when source is GitHub Actions. If source stays legacy, it skips deployment and the committed root index.html fallback serves the site instead of README.md.

features.name: Root fallback + website validator
features.details: build_website.py now generates web/index.html, a root index.html fallback, .nojekyll, 404 pages, site.webmanifest, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and embeds both the feature catalog and canonical FastFlag allowlist. Its --check mode validates placeholders, local references, JSON, manifest, and allowlist output.

features.name: Searchable command palette
features.details: Ctrl/Cmd+K or / opens a keyboard-navigable palette with 13 actions for tabs, generated CLI commands, downloads, releases, the FastFlag allowlist, safety docs, low-motion focus mode, and the local Script Hub preview. No dynamic code execution.

features.name: Lightweight CSS starfield and visual effects
features.details: Uses a static CSS starfield and gradient backdrop, modest tab/reveal/counter interactions, and an optional low-motion focus mode. No canvas rendering loop, WebGL, GPU bloom, or cursor-follow spotlight.

features.name: Canonical FastFlag allowlist
features.details: Adds fastflags-allowlist.json as the single source of truth for 18 Roblox local ClientAppSettings.json flags in Geometry, Rendering, and User Interface categories. Python and .NET load/validate the same list, the CLI exposes it with --allowlist/allowlist, the website Docs tab renders it, and the WPF app has a dedicated Allowlist page. The legacy FPS flag is explicitly excluded, and telemetry/exploit/anti-cheat flags are rejected.

features.name: Roblox game script executor / exploit loader
features.details: No game script execution, loadstring, executor API, remote script hub, process attachment, or anti-cheat bypass. The Script Hub is strictly a local UI/documentation preview.

features.name: Rust + Tauri v2 standalone Windows client
features.details: Guided x64 NSIS setup wizard for the primary Rust + Tauri Windows client. It uses the built-in WebView2 runtime, has its own Main and grouped Settings UI (Rendering, Geometry, Icons, Allowlist), detects Roblox locally, and manages only allowlisted reversible settings. The Windows app offers System default, Direct3D 11, Vulkan, or OpenGL and the limited local process-name scan.

features.name: Roblox detection on first launch
features.details: On first open the Windows client detects whether Roblox is installed by scanning standard version folders and ClientSettings paths (read-only, OS-level). No process attachment, memory reads, or launching Roblox. Results appear on the standalone Main page.

features.name: Windows-only standalone desktop settings manager
features.details: The website has a Client tab; the standalone Rust + Tauri app has a Main page plus grouped Settings sections for Rendering, Geometry, Icons, and Allowlist. The settings manager is Windows-only; the macOS companion is a separate legacy tool.

features.name: Allowlist features: what each flag improves
features.details: The canonical allowlist includes categoryDescriptions and per-flag feature descriptions for all 18 Geometry, Rendering, and User Interface flags. The website and the standalone desktop Allowlist section show searchable flag names and improvement descriptions.

features.name: Three.js / WebGL website scene
features.details: Removed from the website to reduce rendering load. The site no longer ships or imports Three.js, a WebGL canvas, or a 3D scene; lightweight CSS gradients and static stars remain.

features.name: Rust safe apply/restore with backups
features.details: Rust backend writes only canonical allowlisted ClientAppSettings.json keys, preserves unrelated keys, creates timestamped backups, and can restore managed keys. Legacy FPS flag is not written.

features.name: Allowlisted rendering API preference
features.details: The standalone Windows app selects System default, Direct3D 11, Vulkan, or OpenGL using only the mutually exclusive canonical allowlisted switches. Direct3D 12 is not included in the allowlist; unsupported renderer flags are never written.

features.name: Local known-executor process-name check
features.details: At startup, every 30 seconds while open, and on request, the Windows app checks exact process image names Xeno.exe, Solara.exe, and JJSploit.exe. Alerts stay in-app; only the image-name field is parsed. Any PID present in tasklist temporary output is ignored and not retained or reported; no paths, command lines, process memory, or network data are collected. This is not antivirus or a complete malware scan. Matches lead to Windows Settings/Windows Security for user review; no process is terminated and no files/software are deleted automatically.

features.name: Dynamic in-game resolution scaling
features.details: Not implemented. The canonical Roblox allowlist has no supported runtime render-scale control. Monitoring game-frame/GPU conditions and changing internal render resolution would cross the app’s no-process-inspection/no-hook boundary. Use Roblox’s official graphics controls instead.

features.name: Force Roblox onto selected CPU cores
features.details: Not implemented. Setting per-process P-core/E-core affinity requires opening and changing the Roblox process, which is outside the local allowlisted-settings boundary. Windows and Roblox retain control of CPU scheduling.

features.name: ExitLag-style route optimization / jitter mitigation
features.details: Not implemented. Route rerouting requires a VPN/relay, driver, or system network-path changes and may send traffic through a third party. Roptimer does not tunnel, intercept, reroute, or optimize Roblox network traffic.

features.name: Optional Electron Windows desktop client
features.details: Adds a separate Electron shell for the standalone desktop UI, alongside the primary Rust + Tauri app. Uses context isolation, sandboxing, no renderer Node integration, a narrow IPC command allowlist, and blocks remote navigation plus HTTP(S)/WebSocket requests. Its local backend preserves the same allowlist-only settings, backups, exact-name process checks, and no-injection/no-memory/no-network boundaries.

features.name: Guided x64 Windows setup wizards
features.details: Configures separate NSIS setup wizards for the Rust + Tauri and Electron apps. Both installers create Start Menu shortcuts and register Windows uninstallers; the Tauri wizard offers a Desktop shortcut option, and the Electron wizard creates a Desktop shortcut. Both can launch the app after setup; no batch launcher is required. The new distribution stops staging the old portable Rust x64 executable.
